people.name: Abimelech
people.line: Son of Gideon, self-proclaimed king of Shechem

people.name: Gideon
people.line: Judge of Israel; defeated Midianites; tested and reassured by God.

translations.web: if you then have dealt truly and righteously with Jerubbaal and with his house today, then rejoice in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you;
translations.bsb: if you have acted faithfully and honestly toward Jerubbaal and his house this day, then may you rejoice in Abimelech, and he in you.
translations.kjv: If ye then have dealt truly and sincerely with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice
translations.asv: if ye then have dealt truly and uprightly with Jerubbaal and with his house this day, then rejoice ye in Abimelech, and let him also rejoice in you:
